text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And so, here you go! Chocolate cookies 
from me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Line 'em up, line 'em up! Here's mine, 
cheesecake!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Here's the tiramisu for this side~

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I left some tarts out for ya! Made a 
bunch, so everyone take some!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"From me, some shrimp crackers to cleanse 
your palate! They're super salty!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Genius!

With that, each of them loaded up trays 
with piles of homemade sweets and began 
setting them out. It was just like—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's an all-you-can-eat sweets buffet! 
Ahaha, this is amazing~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Insane! Totally nuts! Tannhauser's 
chocolate cookies are rainbow-delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!? I wanna eat some too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios's cheesecake and Ms. Palmer's 
shrimp crackers are totally 
rainbow-licious too~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haaah. Valentine's Day really is so much 
fun~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, I know!

Today is Valentine's Day. As I was working 
in the trainer's office as usual—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
""Oh, Trainer? Do you have some time right 
now?""

I was invited to a cafe by Machikane 
Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer, over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
We're having a Valentine's party! It's 
super fun, so I was thinking maybe you'd 
like to join in too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's a Valentine's buffet where we line up 
all the sweets and eat our fill!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I made those cookies... Oh, let me go grab 
them!

After a short while, she came back with 
homemade chocolate cookies for me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad if it suits your taste. Please, 
dig in!
Just as I was about to dig in right away—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, those are Rainbow Uma, Super-Uma 
Cookies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Tannhauser was agonizing in front 
of the cookies, wondering "Which one looks 
the tastiest~?" though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aha, so that's what was going on.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? B-B-But of course I want you to eat 
the absolute most delicious one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Come on, hurry up and eat, Trainer!"

Machikane Tannhauser's cookies lived up to 
their reputation, being perfectly crisp, 
crumbly, and utterly delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Tannhauser, did you 
prepare something for your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mm, of course. I made macarons.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ya made it separately!? You're 
really fired up, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
F-Fighting spirit!? No, no, that wasn't 
what I meant at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And macarons, of all things...!? Those are 
super tricky to make! Way to go~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you know how Valentine's sweets 
sometimes have hidden meanings, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Is that so!?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"Cookies for us, and macarons for the 
Trainer—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Oho?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I shouldn't have said that...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm gonna get weirdly nervous 
when I hand it over to you, Trainer...

After school on Valentine's Day, a 
strangely composed Machikane Tannhauser 
came by the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...E-Excuse me for intruding.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, it's totally nothing! Nothing at 
all, I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
M-More importantly, here you go! Happy 
Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
These macarons are made lightly sweet. I 
hope you like them.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um, please don't look up what giving 
macarons means, okay! It was totally, 
totally a coincidence~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You definitely can't do that!

Hearing all that piqued my curiosity... 
but in any case, the macarons I received 
were crafted with great care and were 
utterly delicious.
